abandon_criterion.note: drop a ladder when two fresh-seed rungs agree below the bar or the trial cap binds

bar.note: entries lacking a certificate or a verified layout

direction.expected_value: A board where every frontier entry carries either a certificate or a documented reason it cannot be certified, and where geometric-efficiency clubs (D=3, stabilizer 2D) gain their first members.
direction.feasibility: certification_queue.py and certify_sweep.py drive certs; layout assignment reuses verify/qldpc_verify.py layout checks. GPU verifies witnesses for laid-out constructions.
direction.hypothesis: A coordinated pass can (a) honor certificates for board entries that lack them and (b) attach honest layouts to entries that have none, opening the geometric-efficiency frontiers that currently have no members.

novelty.against: committed codes/ entries, certs/, and the layout tier
novelty.claim: honored certificates and honest layouts for entries that currently have neither

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: That certification and layout assignment are bottlenecked by time rather than method, justifying larger budgets or revised caps.

campaign.name: Board-wide certification and layout campaign
campaign.notes: Part A: work the certification queue (research/certs/todo.json) with sat_certify/tropidist and file honored certs. Part B: construct and verify honest 2D/3D layouts for entries that have none, targeting the empty geometric-efficiency clubs (D=3, stabilizer 2D). GPU resolves witnesses for laid-out constructions. No verifier changes.
